feature_schema.jpn_indexed: boolean; Japanese sentence has an official jpn_indices entry
feature_schema.pair_created_at: nullable provider datetime string; maximum of both sentence creation values; null unless both valid
feature_schema.pair_modified_at: nullable provider datetime string; maximum of both sentence modification values; null unless both valid
feature_schema.wordfreq_zipf_milli: wordfreq 3.0.2 whole-English-text Zipf frequency multiplied by 1000 and rounded

source_snapshot.date_semantics: timezone-less provider sentence-row created/modified values; pair fields are max-of-both proxies, not link age
source_snapshot.normalization: candidate-restricted app-owned pair features; no provider coordinates
source_snapshot.provider_license: CC BY 2.0 FR unless per-record CC0; audio bytes excluded
